resources.string: Hold the assistant gesture on any screen, ask out loud, and the screenshot goes to your bot.
https://… used when the ImgBB key is empty

The screenshot is uploaded first. The webhook gets a temporary https link, not the image bytes. ImgBB links expire after 6 hours. A custom host receives a JPEG field named image and returns an https URL.
Webhook must be an https URL.
Image host must be an https URL.
Couldn\'t store the secret on this phone.
Ask Button is the digital assistant.
Ask Button is not the digital assistant yet.
This phone has no digital assistant slot. Use the Quick Settings tile.

Stock Android: Settings, Apps, Default apps, Digital assistant app, Ask Button. Then long-press Home, or swipe in from a bottom corner if that gesture is available.

Samsung One UI: Settings, Apps, Default apps (or Choose default apps), Digital assistant app. Long-press Home if you use buttons. One UI 7 has no corner swipe. Add the Ask Button Quick Settings tile, or long-press the app icon and tap Ask about this screen.

A power-button shortcut is optional. The app does not need one.
A bot can open androidassistbot://setup?webhook=…&auth=… after install. A QR code of that link works with the camera app. auth is the Authorization header value, usually Bearer and the key.
Or type a question. Send can be empty.
Allow the microphone in Ask Button, or type your question.
